##### Project general facts

Trinity Residences is a residential tower by Karma Developers, offering a resort-inspired address that pairs sleek modern architecture with an extensive outdoor amenity podium. The building comprises 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, designed with floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary finishes that bring abundant natural light into every room; select layouts include a private jacuzzi on the balcony. The concept leans into resort living throughout — from the infinity pool at its centre to the landscaped gardens and grand welcome lobby that set the tone on arrival.

The amenity offering is extensive and covers most of daily life within the building itself: an infinity pool, jogging track, BBQ zone and dog park sit alongside a fully equipped gym with steam room and sauna, a panoramic gymnasium, and courts for basketball, volleyball and paddle tennis. A dedicated kids' aquatic area brings water features and a splash pad for younger residents, while the wider leisure offering includes a jacuzzi, swim-up bar, yoga space, outdoor cinema, family seating areas and dedicated Instagram spots. Practical living is supported by separate men's and women's changing rooms, a covered car park, and concierge-level on-call services — housekeeping, nanny and doctor.

Apartments are delivered unfurnished, with a complete developer finish: fully equipped, fitted kitchens, contemporary bathroom fittings, and spacious terraces or balconies opening off the living and dining areas.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a residential community in Dubai's southern belt, sitting between Al Barsha South and Dubailand. It combines a walkable, low-to-mid-rise streetscape with a strong sense of neighbourhood, offering contemporary homes alongside everyday convenience — schools, shops and cafés are all within easy reach.

The area benefits from quick access to the wider city: Dubai Hills Mall and Dubai Miracle Garden are just minutes away, with Mall of the Emirates, Arabian Ranches and Global Village all within a short drive. Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Palm Jumeirah are reachable in under 20 minutes, and Dubai International Airport sits around 22 minutes away. Parkview Hospital and a number of well-regarded schools, including Australian International School (DXB), serve the immediate neighbourhood, while supermarkets such as Carrefour, Viva and Nesto cover everyday needs.

Property in this part of Dubai is held on a freehold basis, and qualifying real estate investment can support eligibility for the UAE's long-term Golden Visa. The area's combination of relative affordability, ongoing development and proximity to established hubs like Dubai Hills positions it as one of the city's steadily growing residential corridors.
